rules.title: Subject Pronouns (Ega olmoshlari)
rules.summary: Ismning o'rniga ishlatiladigan qisqa so'zlar: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Gapda ular ega (kim? nima?) bo'ladi.

sections.body:
Bir odam yoki narsa nomini qayta-qayta aytmaslik uchun olmosh ishlatamiz. Olmosh ega (kim? nima?) vazifasida gap boshida turadi.
• I = men
• you = sen / siz
• he = u (erkak)
• she = u (ayol)
• it = u (narsa yoki hayvon)
• we = biz
• they = ular (odamlar ham, narsalar ham)

Ikki savolga javob bering: nechta? va kim yoki nima?
• Bitta erkak -> he
• Bitta ayol -> she
• Bitta narsa yoki hayvon -> it
• Bir nechta (kim yoki nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar) -> they
Masalan: Tom -> he, Anna -> she, the book -> it, Tom and Anna -> they.

O'zbek tilida 'u' so'zi erkak, ayol va narsa uchun bir xil. Inglizchada esa uchta alohida so'z bor: he, she, it. Yana bir farq: inglizcha gapda ega doim aytilishi shart. O'zbekcha 'Boraman' deymiz, inglizcha 'I go' - 'I' tashlab ketilmaydi.
Yana: 'you' ham 'sen', ham 'siz', ham 'sizlar' degani - hurmat shakli alohida emas.

• 'I' har doim katta harf bilan yoziladi, gap o'rtasida ham.
• Hayvonni odatda 'it' deymiz, lekin uy hayvoniga ismi bilan murojaat qilsak 'he' yoki 'she' ham bo'ladi.
• Ko'plikda erkak-ayol farqi yo'q: boys, girls, books - hammasi they.

examples.en: Anna and I are teachers. We like English.
examples.uz: Anna va men o'qituvchimiz. Biz ingliz tilini yaxshi ko'ramiz.

examples.en: Where is the key? It is on the table.

mistakes.wrong: The cat is big. He is white.
mistakes.right: The cat is big. It is white.

mistakes.wrong: Tom and Ali, he is here.
mistakes.right: Tom and Ali, they are here.

mistakes.why: 'I' har doim katta harf bilan yoziladi.

rules.tip: Bittami - he/she/it. Ko'pmi - they. Bitta ayol she, bitta erkak he, qolgan hamma bitta narsa it.

quiz.q: Maria is my friend. ___ is from Spain.
The books are new. ___ are on the shelf.
My bag is red. ___ is old.

rules.title: The Verb 'to be' (am / is / are)
rules.summary: 'To be' (bo'lmoq) fe'li: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are. Odam yoki narsa kim yoki qanday ekanini aytadi.

sections.body:
'To be' fe'li bilan kim ekanimizni, qayerdaligimizni, qandayligimizni aytamiz. O'zbekchada buni '-man, -san, -miz' qo'shimchalari bajaradi, inglizchada esa alohida so'z kerak.
• Ism va kasb: I am Ali. She is a doctor.
• Joy: We are at school.
• Sifat: It is cold.

Tasdiq:
I am / I'm
you are / you're
he is / he's
she is / she's
it is / it's
we are / we're
they are / they're

So'roq: fe'l oldinga chiqadi - Am I...? Are you...? Is she...?
Inkor: not qo'shiladi - I am not (I'm not), he is not (he isn't), we are not (we aren't).

Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, he isn't.
O'zbekchada 'Men talabaman' - 'bo'lmoq' so'zi aytilmaydi. Inglizchada 'I student' deb bo'lmaydi, 'I am a student' deyiladi. 'Is' va 'are' ni tashlab ketmang.

• 'You' bir kishiga ham, ko'pga ham 'are' bilan: you are.
• Ko'plikdagi ega (the boys, my parents) ham 'are' oladi.
• Qisqa shakllar og'zaki nutqda juda ko'p: I'm, he's, they're.
• Qisqa tasdiq javobda qisqartirilmaydi: Yes, I am (Yes, I'm emas).

examples.en: It is not far from here.
Is he your brother? No, he isn't.

mistakes.wrong: Are you a teacher? Yes, I'm.
mistakes.right: Are you a teacher? Yes, I am.

rules.tip: I - am, he/she/it - is, you/we/they - are. 'Men' bilan faqat 'am'!

quiz.why: You bilan are, so'roqda oldinga chiqadi.
We bilan are: we are not (we aren't).

rules.title: A / An (noaniq artikl)
rules.summary: 'A' va 'an' - 'bitta' ma'nosidagi kichik so'zlar. Qaysi birini tanlash so'zning birinchi TOVUSHIGA bog'liq, harfiga emas.

sections.body:
A yoki an - sanaladigan ot birlikda bo'lsa va 'qaysidir bitta' desak qo'yiladi.
• a book (bitta kitob)
• an apple (bitta olma)
Ko'plikda a/an ishlatilmaydi: books, apples.

So'zning birinchi TOVUSHIGA qarang:
• Undosh tovush bilan boshlansa -> a: a car, a pen, a house
• Unli tovush bilan boshlansa -> an: an egg, an orange, an umbrella
Harf emas, tovush hal qiladi:
• an hour (h aytilmaydi)
• a university (birinchi tovush 'yu', undosh tovush)
• a uniform
O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q, 'bir' so'zini esa ko'pincha tashlab ketamiz: 'Menda mashina bor'. Inglizchada sanaladigan birlik otdan oldin a/an kerak: I have a car.

• Kasb aytganda ham: She is a teacher. He is an engineer.
• Sifat ot oldida bo'lsa, sifatning birinchi tovushiga qaraladi: an old car, a new car.
• Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan a/an ishlatilmaydi: water, rice, milk.

examples.en: She eats an apple every day.
My father works at a university.
Is it a pen or a pencil?

mistakes.why: 'University' 'yu' tovushi bilan boshlanadi, bu undosh tovush - a.

rules.tip: Harfga emas, eshitilgan birinchi tovushga qarang: an hour, a university.

quiz.why: Doctor undosh tovush (d) bilan boshlanadi - a.
Orange unli tovush bilan boshlanadi - an.

rules.title: Have got / Has got (egalik)
rules.summary: 'Have got' bilan nimadir bizda bor ekanini aytamiz: I have got a bike. He/She/It uchun 'has got'.

sections.body:
Egalik, oila a'zolari, tashqi ko'rinish va kasallik haqida gapirganda:
• I have got a car. (Menda mashina bor.)
• She has got two brothers.
• He has got blue eyes.
• I have got a headache.

Tasdiq:
I/you/we/they have got (I've got)
he/she/it has got (he's got)

So'roq: Have/Has + ega + got?
Have you got a pen? Has she got a sister?

Inkor: have not (haven't) got, has not (hasn't) got
I haven't got a car. He hasn't got a dog.

Qisqa javob: Yes, I have. / No, she hasn't. ('got' aytilmaydi.)
O'zbekchada 'menda bor' deymiz. Inglizchada ega - men: 'I have got'. 'Menda' o'rniga 'I' kerak, 'got' esa fe'lning bir qismi.

• 'Have got' va 'have' ma'nosi bir xil: I've got a book = I have a book.
• Inkor gapda 'or' ishlatiladi: He hasn't got a pen or a pencil.
• 'Has' faqat he/she/it bilan.

examples.en: I have got a new phone.
Has he got a car? No, he hasn't.

mistakes.wrong: Has she got a dog? Yes, she has got.
mistakes.right: Has she got a dog? Yes, she has.

mistakes.wrong: I haven't got a pen and a pencil.
mistakes.right: I haven't got a pen or a pencil.

mistakes.wrong: Do you have got a car?

rules.tip: I/you/we/they - have got, he/she/it - has got. So'roqda have/has oldinga chiqadi.

quiz.why: My sister = she, demak has got.

rules.title: Can (qila olish)
rules.summary: 'Can' - qila olaman degan ma'noni beradi: I can swim. Hamma shaxsda bir xil, fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi.

sections.body:
Can bilan nimani qila olishimizni yoki ruxsat iltimos qilishni aytamiz.
• I can swim. (Men suza olaman.)
• She can speak English.
• Can I open the window? (Derazani ochsam bo'ladimi?)

Tasdiq: ega + can + fe'l (asosiy shakl)
He can run. They can sing.

So'roq: Can + ega + fe'l?
Can you swim?

Inkor: cannot / can't
I can't drive.

Qisqa javob: Yes, I can. / No, he can't.

Savol so'zi bilan: What can you do? - I can cook.
O'zbekchada 'suza olaman' - fe'lga '-a olaman' qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi. Inglizchada alohida so'z 'can' fe'ldan oldin turadi. Fe'l o'zgarmaydi: she can swim (swims emas).

• Can dan keyin 'to' qo'yilmaydi: I can swim.
• Hamma shaxsda bir xil: I can, he can, they can.
• 'Cannot' bir so'z bo'lib yoziladi, qisqasi can't.
• Can + ega + fe'l? so'roq oson: Can she play tennis?

examples.en: Can your brother play the guitar? Yes, he can.
We can't see the sea from here.
examples.uz: Biz bu yerdan dengizni ko'ra olmaymiz.

examples.en: What can you do? I can dance.
examples.uz: Siz nima qila olasiz? Men raqsga tusha olaman.

mistakes.why: can o'zi oldinga chiqadi, 'do' kerak emas.
can dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda.

rules.tip: Can + fe'l asosi. Na 's', na 'to', na 'do'.

quiz.q: He ___ drive. He is only ten.

rules.title: Qisqa javoblar: can va have got
rules.summary: Ha/yo'q savollariga qisqa javob berish: Yes, I can. / No, she hasn't. Asosiy fe'lni takrorlamaymiz.

sections.body:
Ha/yo'q bilan javob beriladigan savollarga to'liq gap shart emas. Savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni (can, have, has) takrorlaymiz.
• Can you swim? - Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
• Have you got a pen? - Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
• Has he got a car? - Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.

Ega o'zgaradi (you -> I, she -> she), fe'l esa savoldan olinadi.
Can she dance? - Yes, she can.
Have they got a dog? - Yes, they have.
Asosiy fe'l (dance) va 'got' qisqa javobda aytilmaydi.
Tasdiq javobda qisqartirma yo'q: Yes, I can. Yes, he has (Yes, he's emas).
O'zbekchada 'Ha' yoki 'Yo'q' yetarli. Inglizchada ham 'Yes' / 'No' dan keyin ega va fe'lni qo'shish odobli va tabiiy: 'Yes, I can.' - faqat 'Yes.' esa biroz quruq eshitiladi.

• You bilan so'ralsa, javobda I ishlatiladi: Can you cook? - Yes, I can.
• Inkorda qisqartirma odatiy: No, I can't. / No, she hasn't.
• Have got savoliga javobda 'got' ishlatilmaydi.

examples.en: Can you cook? Yes, I can.
Can he drive? No, he can't.
Have you got a sister? Yes, I have.
Has she got a bike? No, she hasn't.
Can they swim? Yes, they can.
Have we got time? No, we haven't.
Can your dog jump? Yes, it can.

mistakes.wrong: Can you swim? Yes, I do.
mistakes.right: Can you swim? Yes, I can.
mistakes.why: Javobda savoldagi yordamchi fe'l takrorlanadi: can.

mistakes.wrong: Has he got a car? Yes, he has got.
mistakes.right: Has he got a car? Yes, he has.

mistakes.wrong: Have you got a pen? Yes, I've.
mistakes.right: Have you got a pen? Yes, I have.

mistakes.wrong: Can she dance? No, she don't.
mistakes.right: Can she dance? No, she can't.

rules.tip: Savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni (can / have / has) ayt - boshqasini emas.

quiz.why: Savolda can bor, javobda ham can.

quiz.q: Has he got a phone? No, he ___.
Have you got a pen? Yes, I ___.

rules.title: Some, Any va A/An
rules.summary: Ot birlikmi yoki ko'plikmi, gap tasdiqmi yoki inkormi - shu ikki savol a/an, some, any dan birini tanlashga yordam beradi.

sections.body:
Qancha ekanini aniq aytmasdan 'bir nechta' desak, some yoki any ishlatamiz.
• Birlik sanaladigan ot -> a / an (tasdiq ham, inkor ham)
• Ko'plik + tasdiq -> some
• Ko'plik + inkor -> any

Tasdiq: There are some apples.
Inkor: There aren't any apples.
So'roq: Are there any apples?
Birlikda: There is an apple. There isn't an apple.
Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ham shunday: There is some milk. There isn't any milk.

O'zbekchada 'ba'zi', 'bir necha' degan so'zlar bor, lekin 'any' ga mos so'z yo'q: 'hech qanday' yoki 'biron' deymiz, ba'zan umuman tashlab ketamiz. Inglizchada ko'plik inkor gapda any ni tashlab bo'lmaydi: There aren't any chairs.

• Taklif va iltimosda so'roq gapda ham some ishlatiladi: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
• Inkor gapda 'not any' ni 'no' bilan almashtirsa bo'ladi: There are no chairs.

examples.en: There is a table in the room.
There are some books on the desk.
examples.uz: Stol ustida bir nechta kitob bor.

examples.en: Are there any pictures on the wall?
There isn't a lamp in the room.

mistakes.why: Apple sanaladigan birlik ot, some emas, an.

rules.tip: Ikki savol: birlikmi-ko'plikmi? tasdiqmi-inkormi? Ko'plik tasdiq - some, ko'plik inkor - any.

quiz.q: There is ___ egg in the fridge.
quiz.why: Egg - sanaladigan birlik, unli tovush: an.

quiz.q: There are ___ flowers in the garden.

rules.title: Plurals (Otlarning ko'pligi)
rules.summary: Ko'plik odatda -s bilan yasaladi, lekin ba'zi otlarda -es va -ies qo'shiladi.

sections.body: Bittadan ko'p narsa haqida gapirganda otga ko'plik qo'shimchasini qo'shamiz. Birlikdagi a/an ko'plikda tushib qoladi: a book -> books.

• Ko'pchilik otlar: -s (cat -> cats, book -> books)
• -s, -sh, -ch, -x bilan tugasa: -es (bus -> buses, dish -> dishes, watch -> watches, box -> boxes)
• Undosh + y: y tushib -ies (baby -> babies, city -> cities)
• Unli + y: oddiy -s (boy -> boys, toy -> toys)
• -o bilan tugaydigan ayrim otlar -es: tomato -> tomatoes, potato -> potatoes (photo -> photos, piano -> pianos)
O'zbekchada ko'plik '-lar' bilan yasaladi, son bilan esa ko'plik shart emas: 'uchta kitob'. Inglizchada son bilan ham ot ko'plikda bo'ladi: three books. 'Three book' xato.

• -f / -fe bilan tugaydiganlar: knife -> knives, leaf -> leaves (ayrim so'zlar).
• Noto'g'ri ko'plik: man -> men, child -> children (6-unitda).
• Talaffuzda -s uchta tovush beradi: cats [s], dogs [z], buses [iz].

rules.tip: So'z oxiriga qarang: s/sh/ch/x - es; undosh+y - ies; boshqasi - s.

rules.title: This, That, These, Those
rules.summary: Yaqin yoki uzoqdagi narsani ko'rsatish uchun: this/these - yaqin, that/those - uzoq. This/that - bitta, these/those - bir nechta.

sections.body:
Ko'rsatish olmoshlari bilan narsa qayerda ekanini aytamiz.
• this = bu (yonimizda, bitta)
• these = bular (yonimizda, bir nechta)
• that = ana u (uzoqda, bitta)
• those = ana ular (uzoqda, bir nechta)

Yaqin:
This is my book. These are my books.
Uzoq:
That is a bus. Those are buses.
So'roq: Is this your pen? Are those your keys?
Ot oldida ham ishlatiladi: this car, those boys.
This/that - is bilan, these/those - are bilan.
O'zbekchada 'bu', 'u', 'mana bu', 'ana u' deymiz va ko'plik uchun '-lar' qo'shamiz: bular, ular. Inglizchada ko'plik uchun alohida so'zlar bor: this -> these, that -> those.

• Ko'plik ot bilan faqat these/those: these books (this books emas).
• Telefon suhbatida: Hello, this is Ali. (Men Aliman.)
• Vaqt haqida ham ishlatiladi: that day (o'sha kun).

rules.tip: This - these yaqin, that - those uzoq. Bitta - this/that, ko'p - these/those.

rules.title: There is / There are
rules.summary: Biror narsa mavjudligini aytish: There is (birlik) va There are (ko'plik).

sections.body:
Xonada, shaharda yoki rasmda nima 'bor' ekanini aytganda there is/there are ishlatamiz.
• There is a bed in the room.
• There are two windows.

Tasdiq: There is / There are
So'roq: Is there...? / Are there...?
Inkor: There isn't / There aren't
Qisqa javob: Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.
Qoida: is - birlik va sanalmaydigan ot bilan, are - ko'plik bilan.
Qisqartma: There's a lamp.
O'zbekchada 'bor' deb aytamiz: 'Xonada stol bor'. Inglizchada 'There' + be shakli kerak: There is a table in the room. 'Have' bu yerda ishlamaydi.

• Bir nechta narsa sanaganda fe'l birinchi otga moslashadi: There is a table and two chairs.
• There is qisqartirilib there's bo'ladi.
• Joy predloglari bilan birga keladi: in, on, under, next to.

examples.en: There is a cat on the sofa.
There are three books on the table.
Is there a bank near here?
Are there any shops in your street?
There isn't a park in my town.
There's some milk in the fridge.

mistakes.wrong: Have a cat on the sofa.
mistakes.right: There is a cat on the sofa.

mistakes.wrong: Is there any books? Yes, there are.
mistakes.right: Are there any books? Yes, there are.

rules.tip: Bitta - there is, bir nechta - there are. Savolda is/are oldinga chiqadi.

quiz.q: There ___ four people in the room.

rules.title: Prepositions of Place (joy predloglari)
rules.summary: Narsa qayerda turganini aytadigan so'zlar: in, on, under, next to, near, between, in front of, behind.

sections.body:
Predlog ot yoki olmosh oldida turib, narsaning joyini ko'rsatadi.
• in = ichida
• on = ustida (sirt bilan tegib)
• under = ostida
• next to / near = yonida / yaqinida
• between = orasida (ikkitasi)
• in front of = oldida
• behind = orqasida

Qolip: Narsa + is/are + predlog + joy.
The cat is on the sofa.
The keys are in the bag.
So'roq: Where is the cat? - It's under the table.
Where are my keys? - They're next to the phone.
O'zbekchada joy qo'shimchalar bilan beriladi: stolda, stol ostida. Inglizchada qo'shimcha o'rniga alohida predlog bor, va u otdan OLDIN turadi: on the table.

• in - ichida yoki chegara ichida: in the box, in the room.
• on - sirt ustida: on the wall (devorda ham), on the floor.
• at home, at work, at school - 'the' yo'q.
• Geografiyada: in the north of Italy (mamlakat ichidagi qism), on the west coast of Greece.

examples.en: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.
The ball is in the box.
The bank is next to the school.
The park is between the shop and the cinema.
The car is in front of the house.
Milan is in the north of Italy.

mistakes.wrong: The book is in the table.
mistakes.right: The book is on the table.
mistakes.why: Sirt ustida turgan narsa uchun on.

mistakes.wrong: The cat is on the box. (ichida)
mistakes.right: The cat is in the box.

mistakes.wrong: Patras is in the west coast of Greece.
mistakes.right: Patras is on the west coast of Greece.

rules.tip: In - ichida, on - ustida, under - ostida. 'At home, at work' - the siz.

quiz.q: Milan is ___ the north of Italy.
quiz.why: Mamlakat ichidagi qism: in the north of.

rules.title: Possessive Adjectives (egalik sifatlari)
rules.summary: my, your, his, her, its, our, their - ot oldida turib, narsa kimniki ekanini bildiradi.

sections.body:
Egalik sifati har doim ot oldida turadi va 'kimning?' savoliga javob beradi.
• my = mening
• your = sening / sizning
• his = uning (erkak)
• her = uning (ayol)
• its = uning (narsa, hayvon)
• our = bizning
• their = ularning
Masalan: my book, her bag, their house.

Olmosh -> egalik sifati:
I -> my
you -> your
he -> his
she -> her
it -> its
we -> our
they -> their
Egalik sifatidan keyin DOIM ot keladi: my car. Artikl (a/the) qo'yilmaydi: 'my the car' xato.

O'zbekchada egalik ot oxiriga qo'shiladi: kitobim, kitobing, kitobi. Inglizchada esa ot oldida alohida so'z turadi: my book, your book, his book. Shuning uchun 'uning' erkak va ayol uchun farqlanadi: his / her.

• Egalik egasining jinsiga bog'liq, narsaning sonidan emas: her brothers (ularning egasi ayol), his sisters.
• Its va it's ni adashtirmang: its = uning, it's = it is.
• Ko'plikdagi ot bilan ham o'zgarmaydi: my book, my books.

examples.en: This is my bag and that is your bag.
examples.uz: Bu mening sumkam, ana u sening sumkang.

mistakes.wrong: He is Ali. Her book is here.
mistakes.right: He is Ali. His book is here.

rules.tip: Egalik sifatidan keyin doim ot: my + ot. 'Egasi kim?' ga qarang: erkak - his, ayol - her.

quiz.q: Anna has a dog. ___ dog is big.

rules.title: Possessive Pronouns (mine, yours...)
rules.summary: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs - o'zi ot o'rnida keladi: 'It is mine' (U meniki).

sections.body:
Ot takrorlanmasligi uchun egalik olmoshi ishlatamiz.
• This is my book. -> This book is mine.
• That is her bag. -> That bag is hers.
Ulardan keyin ot kelmaydi.

my -> mine
your -> yours
his -> his
her -> hers
our -> ours
their -> theirs
'Its' uchun odatda egalik olmoshi ishlatilmaydi.
Savol: Whose book is this? - It's mine / It's Anna's.
O'zbekchada 'meniki', 'seniki', 'uniki', 'bizniki', 'ularniki' deymiz, ya'ni '-niki' qo'shimchasi. Inglizchada bu mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs.

• Egalik sifati + ot yoki egalik olmoshi: my pen = mine.
• Apostrof YO'Q: yours, hers, ours, theirs (your's - xato).
• His ikkala shaklda ham o'zgarmaydi: his book / the book is his.

examples.en: Whose phone is this? It's mine.
My room is big, but yours is small.
examples.uz: Mening xonam katta, seniki esa kichik.

mistakes.why: Ot oldida mine emas, my (egalik sifati).
yours, hers, ours, theirs da apostrof yo'q.

rules.tip: Ot bor - my / her. Ot yo'q - mine / hers.

quiz.q: That bag isn't mine. It's ___ (u, ayol).
Is this your pen? Yes, it's ___.
These are our books. They are ___.

rules.title: Possessive 's (egalik kelishigi)
rules.summary: 's bilan egalikni ifodalaymiz: Ali's book (Alining kitobi). Ko'plikda -s dan keyin faqat apostrof: the boys' room.

sections.body:
Egalik odam yoki hayvon nomi bilan aytilsa, 'ning' ma'nosida 's qo'shamiz.
• Ali's book = Alining kitobi
• my mother's car = onamning mashinasi
Savol: Whose book is this? - It's Ali's.

• Birlik: ot + 's -> the girl's bag, Tom's phone
• -s bilan tugaydigan ko'plik: ot + ' -> the boys' room, my parents' house
• -s bilan tugamaydigan ko'plik: ot + 's -> the children's toys, the men's shoes
Tarkib: egasi + 's + narsa. O'zbekchadan farqli, inglizchada egasi AVVAL keladi, keyin narsa.
O'zbekchada '-ning' qo'shimchasi: Alining kitobi. Inglizchada 's: Ali's book. Tartib bir xil: avval egasi, keyin narsa.

• Jonsiz narsalarda odatda 's ishlatilmaydi: the door of the room (the room's door kam).
• 's boshqa vazifada ham keladi: Ali's a student = Ali is a student. Ma'noga qarang.
• Ismlar -s bilan tugasa ham 's bo'ladi: James's bag.

examples.en: The children's toys are on the floor.
Whose book is it? It's Tom's.
My parents' house is in the city.

mistakes.wrong: The book of Ali is here.

rules.tip: Egasi + 's + narsa. Ko'plik -s dan keyin faqat '.

rules.title: Present Simple: tasdiq va -s imlosi
rules.summary: Odat va doimiy ishlar haqida gapirishda ishlatiladi. He/she/it bilan fe'lga -s yoki -es qo'shiladi.

sections.body:
Present Simple (oddiy hozirgi zamon) odat, doimiy ish va umumiy haqiqatni bildiradi.
• I work in a bank. (doimiy ish)
• She gets up at seven. (odat)
• The sun rises in the east. (umumiy haqiqat)

I / you / we / they + fe'l (work)
he / she / it + fe'l-s (works)

-s qo'shishning qoidalari:
1) Ko'pchilik fe'llar: -s (work -> works, play -> plays)
2) -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa: -es (finish -> finishes, watch -> watches, go -> goes)
3) Undosh + y: y tushib -ies (fly -> flies, study -> studies)
4) Unli + y: oddiy -s (play -> plays, buy -> buys)
Yodda: have -> has (he has, she has).
O'zbekchada fe'l shaxs va songa qarab o'zgaradi: ishlayman, ishlaysan, ishlaydi. Inglizchada deyarli hamma shaxsda fe'l bir xil, faqat he/she/it bilan -s qo'shiladi: I work, he works.

• Faqat birlikdagi 3-shaxs: he, she, it va birlik ot (my mother works).
• Ko'plikda -s yo'q: my parents work.
• -es qo'shilganda talaffuz: finishes [iz]. Oddiy -s: works [s], plays [z].

examples.en: He goes to school by bus.
My mother watches TV in the evening.
It rains a lot in April.

rules.tip: He, she, it - fe'lga -s! Oxiriga qarang: s/sh/ch/x/o - es, undosh+y - ies.

rules.title: Present Simple: inkor va so'roq (do / does)
rules.summary: Inkor va so'roq do/does yordamida yasaladi. Does bo'lsa, asosiy fe'lda -s bo'lmaydi.

sections.body:
Present Simple da 'ishlamaydi' yoki 'ishlaydimi?' deyish uchun yordamchi fe'l kerak: do yoki does.
• I don't like tea.
• Does she work here?

Inkor:
I / you / we / they + don't + fe'l
he / she / it + doesn't + fe'l
So'roq:
Do + I / you / we / they + fe'l?
Does + he / she / it + fe'l?
Qisqa javob: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
MUHIM: does yoki doesn't bo'lsa, asosiy fe'l asosiy shaklda: She doesn't work. (works emas)
So'roq so'zi bilan: Where does he live? What do you do?
O'zbekchada inkor fe'lga '-ma' qo'shimchasi bilan: ishlamaydi. So'roq '-mi' bilan: ishlaydimi? Inglizchada esa yordamchi fe'l (do/does) gap boshiga chiqadi va asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.

• -s faqat bitta joyda bo'ladi: yordamchi fe'lda (does) - asosiy fe'lda emas.
• 'To be' bilan do/does ishlatilmaydi: Is she a doctor? (Does she is - xato).
• Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

rules.tip: -s faqat bir joyda: does bor - fe'lda -s yo'q.

rules.title: Adverbs of Frequency (chastota ravishlari)
rules.summary: Ish qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishini bildiradi: always, usually, often, sometimes, never. Odatda asosiy fe'ldan oldin turadi.

sections.body:
Chastota ravishlari odat va takrorlanuvchi ishlar haqida gapirganda Present Simple bilan ishlatiladi.
• always = doim (100%)
• usually = odatda
• often = tez-tez
• sometimes = ba'zan
• hardly ever = deyarli hech
• never = hech qachon (0%)

Asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN: I always get up early. She never eats meat.
'To be' fe'lidan KEYIN: He is always late. They are never at home.
So'roq: Do you often go there? Are you always tired?
Ba'zi iboralar gap oxirida ham keladi: every day, once a week, twice a month.
sometimes ba'zan gap boshida ham turadi: Sometimes I walk to work.
O'zbekchada 'doim', 'ba'zan' ravishlari gapning boshida ham, o'rtasida ham turaveradi. Inglizchada tartib qat'iyroq: fe'ldan oldin (to be dan keyin).

• Never o'zi inkor ma'noli, shuning uchun don't qo'shilmaydi: I never drink tea (I don't never emas).
• Inkor gapda always/usually: She doesn't always eat breakfast.
• 'How often...?' - qanchalik tez-tez? - degan savol.

examples.en: I always get up at six.
We often watch TV in the evening.
How often do you go to the cinema?
My father is never at home on Sundays.
examples.uz: Dadam yakshanba kuni hech qachon uyda bo'lmaydi.

mistakes.why: Never o'zi inkor, qo'shimcha don't kerak emas.

mistakes.wrong: He usually goes not to work.
mistakes.right: He doesn't usually go to work.

rules.tip: Fe'ldan oldin, 'to be' dan keyin. Never bilan don't ishlatilmaydi.

quiz.why: To be dan keyin: is usually.
Never o'zi inkor: I never drink.

rules.title: Prepositions of Time (at, in, on)
rules.summary: At - aniq vaqt, on - kun va sana, in - oy, fasl, yil va kun qismlari.

sections.body:
Vaqt predloglari 'qachon?' savoliga javob beradi.
• at = aniq soat va ba'zi iboralar: at 7 o'clock, at night, at noon, at the weekend
• on = kunlar va sanalar: on Monday, on 5th May, on my birthday
• in = oy, fasl, yil, kun qismi: in May, in summer, in 2024, in the morning/afternoon/evening

Qolip: fe'l + predlog + vaqt.
The lesson starts at nine.
I go to school on weekdays.
We go to the sea in summer.
Tushuntirish: at - 'nuqta' (aniq vaqt), on - 'kun', in - 'uzoq davr'.
Katta harf: oylar, hafta kunlari, millat va tillar - katta harf bilan (Monday, May, English). Fasllar va kun qismlari - kichik harf bilan (summer, morning).
O'zbekchada vaqt qo'shimchalar bilan: soat to'qqizda, dushanba kuni, yozda, 2024-yilda. Inglizchada har xil vaqt turi uchun har xil predlog: at nine, on Monday, in summer, in 2024.

• Sanalarda predlog on, sana the va of bilan aytiladi: on the 5th of May.
• at night (kechasi), lekin in the morning (ertalab).
• Predlog this, next, last, every bilan ishlatilmaydi: next Monday, every day.

examples.uz: Menda dushanba kuni ingliz tili bor.

examples.en: We have breakfast in the morning.
He goes to the mosque on Friday.

mistakes.wrong: I get up in seven o'clock.
mistakes.right: I get up at seven o'clock.

rules.tip: Soat - at, kun va sana - on, oy/fasl/yil - in. Oylar va kunlar katta harf bilan.

rules.title: Present Simple: savol so'zlari bilan so'roq
rules.summary: Savol so'zi (what, where, when...) + do/does + ega + asosiy fe'l. Ega so'ralsa (who) do/does kerak emas.

sections.body:
Aniq ma'lumot so'rash uchun savol so'zlaridan foydalanamiz.
• What do you do? (Nima ish qilasiz?)
• Where does she live?
• When do you get up?
• How often do they play?

Savol so'zi + do/does + ega + fe'l (asosiy shakl)?
Where do you work?
What time does the film start?
Why does he study English?
Javob to'liq gap bilan beriladi: I work in a bank. / He lives in Tashkent.
Ega so'ralganda (kim?) do/does ishlatilmaydi va fe'lga -s qo'shiladi:
Who lives here? - Tom does.
Who works in a bank? - My father.
O'zbekchada savol so'zi odatda gap o'rtasida turadi: Siz qayerda ishlaysiz? Inglizchada savol so'zi gap boshiga chiqadi va undan keyin do/does turadi.

• Does bilan asosiy fe'lda -s bo'lmaydi: Where does he live? (lives emas).
• 'Who' ega bo'lib kelganda: Who plays tennis? (do/does yo'q).
• Savol so'zlari 6-unitda to'liq ro'yxat bilan.

examples.en: What time does the film start?
How often do they play tennis?

mistakes.why: Savol so'zidan keyin do/does + ega + fe'l.

rules.tip: Savol so'zi + do/does + ega + fe'l asosi. Does bor - fe'lda -s yo'q.

rules.title: Sanalar (Dates)
rules.summary: Inglizcha sanalarda tartib so'zi (ordinal) ishlatiladi: 5th May yoki May 5th. Oylar va kunlar katta harf bilan yoziladi.

sections.body:
Sana aytishda sonlar tartib shaklida bo'ladi: first (1st), second (2nd), third (3rd), fourth (4th)...
Bu sana, tug'ilgan kun, bayramlar haqida gapirganda kerak.

Tartib sonlar:
• 1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third
• 4-dan boshlab: raqam + th (4th fourth, 5th fifth, 10th tenth)
• 12th twelfth, 21st twenty-first, 22nd twenty-second
Yozilishi: 5th May yoki May 5th.
Aytilishi: the fifth of May / May the fifth.
Yil: 1999 - nineteen ninety-nine, 2024 - twenty twenty-four.
Savol: What is the date today? - It's the 5th of May. When is your birthday? - It's on 5th May.
O'zbekchada sana 'beshinchi may' yoki '5-may', tartib son '-inchi' bilan. Inglizchada ham tartib son kerak, va 'the' hamda 'of' qo'shiladi: the fifth of May.

• Oylar va hafta kunlari doim katta harf bilan.
• Sana oldida on, oy oldida in: on 5th May, in May.
• Kun nomi bilan qismi ham on: on Monday morning (lekin faqat in the morning).

examples.en: Today is the first of June.
When is your birthday? It's on 3rd August.
The exam is on the twelfth of May.

mistakes.why: Sana bilan on, oy bilan in.
Hafta kuni - on va katta harf.

rules.tip: 1st, 2nd, 3rd - alohida. 4-dan boshlab -th. Oylar va kunlar katta harf bilan.

quiz.q: The ___ day of the week is Monday. (1)

rules.title: Question Words (so'roq so'zlari)
rules.summary: Who, what, where, when, why, how... - aniq ma'lumot so'rash uchun. Ularning ortidan do/does yoki to be keladi.

sections.body:
Ha/yo'q bilan javob berib bo'lmaydigan savollar uchun so'roq so'zi kerak.
• who = kim? (odam)
• what = nima?
• where = qayerda?
• when = qachon?
• why = nega? (javob: Because...)
• how = qanday?
• how much = qancha? (sanalmaydigan, narx)
• how many = nechta? (sanaladigan)
• how often = qanchalik tez-tez?
• how long = qancha vaqt? / qancha uzun?

So'roq so'zi + do/does + ega + fe'l asosi?
Where do kangaroos live?
What does she eat?
'To be' bilan: So'roq so'zi + is/are + ega?
Where is the station? Who are those men?
Javoblar: Where? - in Australia. Why? - Because it's cold. When? - at six. How many? - three.
O'zbekchada savol so'zi odatda gap ichida o'z o'rnida turadi: 'Kengurular qayerda yashaydi?'. Inglizchada u gap boshiga chiqadi va keyin yordamchi fe'l (do/does) turadi.

• How much - sanalmaydigan otlar va narx bilan: How much milk? How much is it?
• How many - sanaladigan ko'plik bilan: How many books?
• Because - 'chunki' (why savoliga javob).
• Ega so'ralsa (who/what), do/does ishlatilmaydi: Who lives here?

examples.en: What does she eat for breakfast?
Why do you learn English? Because I like it.
examples.uz: Nega ingliz tilini o'rganasiz? Chunki yoqadi.

examples.en: How many books do you have?
How often do you go to the gym?

mistakes.why: Savol so'zidan keyin do/does + ega + fe'l.

mistakes.wrong: How many water do you drink?
mistakes.right: How much water do you drink?

mistakes.wrong: Why do you learn English? Because to speak.
mistakes.right: Why do you learn English? Because I want to speak.

rules.tip: Sanasang - how many, sanalmasa - how much. Savol so'zi + do/does + ega + fe'l.

quiz.q: ___ do you go to bed? At eleven.

rules.title: Irregular Plurals (noto'g'ri ko'plik)
rules.summary: Ba'zi otlar -s bilan ko'paymaydi: man -> men, child -> children. Ba'zilari o'zgarmaydi: sheep, fish.

sections.body: Odatiy ko'plik -s bilan, lekin kundalik hayotdagi eng ko'p ishlatiladigan bir necha ot o'z qoidasi bo'yicha ko'payadi. Ularni yodlab olish kerak.

1) Ildiz o'zgaradi:
man -> men
woman -> women
child -> children
person -> people
tooth -> teeth
foot -> feet
mouse -> mice
2) Shakl o'zgarmaydi:
sheep -> sheep
fish -> fish
deer -> deer
Bularga -s qo'shilmaydi. Ko'plik fe'li: The children are happy. People are kind.
O'zbekchada ko'plik doim '-lar': bolalar, ayollar, qo'ylar. Inglizchada bunday umumiy qoida bu so'zlarga ishlamaydi, shuning uchun 'childs', 'sheeps' xato.

• People odatda ko'plik: People are friendly (People is emas).
• Son bilan: three children, five sheep, two fish.
• Foot -> feet: bir oyoq, ikki oyoq. Tooth -> teeth.

examples.en: There are two men in the room.
Three women are in the shop.
The children are in the garden.
There are two fish in the lake.
Many people live in this city.

rules.tip: Man-men, woman-women, child-children, person-people. Sheep va fish o'zgarmaydi.

rules.title: Sanash: sonlar va ko'plik
rules.summary: Son 1 dan katta bo'lsa, ot ko'plikda bo'ladi. Bittalikda a/an, ko'plikda esa a/an yo'q.

sections.body:
Narsalarni sanayotganda son va ot birga ishlatiladi.
• one + birlik ot: one cat
• two, three, ... + ko'plik ot: two cats, three giraffes
Savol: How many cats can you see? - I can see three cats.

Qolip: I can see + son + ko'plik ot.
I can see three giraffes.
I can see two children.
I can see five sheep.
Savol: How many + ko'plik ot + can you see?
Noto'g'ri ko'plikni unutmang: men, women, children, sheep, fish.
O'zbekchada son bilan ot birlikda turadi: uchta kitob, beshta bola. Inglizchada ot son bilan ko'plikka o'tadi: three books, five children.

• 1 bilan birlik: one book (books emas).
• 0 (zero) va undan katta sonlar ko'plik: zero books kam ishlatiladi, odatda 'no books'.
• Sanalmaydigan otlar sanalmaydi: two waters emas, two glasses of water (miqdor so'zi bilan).

examples.en: There are five children in the park.
I can see two men and four women.
examples.uz: Men ikkita erkak va to'rtta ayolni ko'raman.

examples.en: There are six fish in the water.
We have two babies in our family.

rules.tip: Bir - birlik, ikki va ko'proq - ko'plik. Noto'g'ri ko'plikni unutmang.

quiz.q: There are four ___ in the room. (woman)

rules.title: Present Continuous: shakli
rules.summary: Hozir, shu daqiqada davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi. Shakli: am/is/are + fe'l-ing.

sections.body:
Present Continuous (hozirgi davomli zamon) gap aytilayotgan paytda bo'layotgan ishni bildiradi.
• I am reading a book now.
• Look! It is raining.
Tez-tez ishlatiladigan vaqt so'zlari: now (hozir), at the moment (shu payt), today, right now.

Tasdiq: ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ing
I'm playing / she's playing / they're playing
So'roq: am/is/are oldinga chiqadi
Am I playing? Is he playing? Are they playing?
Inkor: am/is/are + not + fe'l-ing
I'm not playing, he isn't playing, we aren't playing
Qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, she isn't.
O'zbekchada 'o'qiyapman', 'o'qimoqdaman' - fe'lga '-yap' qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi. Inglizchada ikki qism bor: 'to be' fe'li + asosiy fe'lning -ing shakli. Ikkalasi ham kerak: 'I reading' xato.

• Be fe'li ega bilan moslashadi: I am, he/she/it is, we/you/they are.
• -ing shaklidan oldin to be tashlab ketilmaydi.
• Ba'zi fe'llar odatda Continuous da ishlatilmaydi: know, like, love, want, understand (I like it - to'g'ri, I am liking - xato).

examples.en: They are playing football in the park.

rules.tip: Be (am/is/are) + fe'l-ing. Ikkalasidan biri tushsa, gap xato.

rules.title: Fe'lga -ing qo'shish imlosi
rules.summary: -ing ko'pchilik fe'llarga oddiy qo'shiladi, lekin -e, undosh qo'shilishi va -ie holatlari bor.

sections.body: Present Continuous da fe'lga -ing qo'shiladi. Imlosi uchta asosiy qoidaga bo'ysunadi.

1) Ko'pchilik fe'llar: oddiy -ing (work -> working, play -> playing)
2) -e bilan tugasa: -e tushadi (make -> making, write -> writing, dance -> dancing)
3) Bitta unli + bitta undosh bilan tugagan qisqa fe'llar: oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi (run -> running, sit -> sitting, swim -> swimming)
Istisno: -ie -> -ying (lie -> lying, die -> dying). -y bilan tugasa y o'zgarmaydi: study -> studying.
O'zbekchada fe'lning ildizi qo'shimcha qo'shilganda ham asosan o'zgarmaydi. Inglizchada esa imlo qoidalari bor, ayniqsa -e tushishi va undoshning ikkilanishi.

• -w, -x, -y bilan tugasa undosh ikkilanmaydi: play -> playing, fix -> fixing.
• Oxiri bosimsiz bo'g'inda ikkilanmaydi: visit -> visiting.
• -ee bilan tugasa e tushmaydi: see -> seeing.

mistakes.why: Write -e bilan tugaydi: e tushadi, undosh ikkilanmaydi.

rules.tip: -e tushadi (making), qisqa fe'lda undosh ikkilanadi (running), qolganlari oddiy (working).

rules.title: Present Continuous: so'roq va qisqa javob
rules.summary: So'roq: am/is/are oldinga chiqadi (Are you working?). Savol so'zi bilan: What are you doing?

sections.body:
Hozir nima bo'layotganini so'rash uchun.
• Are you listening?
• What is he doing?
• Where are they going?

Ha/yo'q savoli: Am/Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ing?
Are you studying? - Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Is she sleeping? - Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
Savol so'zi bilan: So'roq so'zi + am/is/are + ega + fe'l-ing?
What are you doing? - I'm reading.
Where is he going? - He's going home.
Qisqa javobda -ing aytilmaydi.
O'zbekchada savol '-mi' bilan: o'qiyapsizmi? Inglizchada esa to be fe'li gap boshiga chiqadi: Are you reading? Gap tartibi o'zgaradi.

• Qisqa javobda to be qisqartirilmaydi (tasdiqda): Yes, I am. (Yes, I'm emas).
• Inkor javobda qisqartirma bo'ladi: No, he isn't.

examples.en: Is she sleeping? No, she isn't.

mistakes.why: Savol so'zidan keyin be, keyin ega.

mistakes.wrong: Are you reading? Yes, I reading.
mistakes.right: Are you reading? Yes, I am.

rules.tip: Be gap boshiga: Are you...? Is she...? Savol so'zi + be + ega + fe'l-ing.

quiz.why: Qisqa inkor: No, I'm not / I am not.

rules.title: Present Simple va Present Continuous
rules.summary: Present Simple - odat va doimiy ishlar, Present Continuous - hozir bo'layotgan ish. Vaqt so'zi ko'p yordam beradi.

sections.body:
• Present Simple: doim yoki tez-tez bo'ladigan, odat qilingan ish.
I play football on Sundays.
• Present Continuous: shu paytda yoki hozirgi atrofda bo'layotgan ish.
I am playing football now.

Present Simple: ega + fe'l (+ s)
She works every day.
Present Continuous: ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ing
She is working now.
Vaqt so'zlariga qarang:
• Simple: every day, always, usually, often, never, on Sundays
• Continuous: now, at the moment, today, right now, Look! Listen!
O'zbekchada 'ishlayman' (odatiy) va 'ishlayapman' (hozir) farqlanadi, '-yap' qo'shimchasi hozirgi davomiylikni beradi. Inglizchada ham xuddi shu farq: work (odatiy) va am working (hozir).

• Like, love, know, want kabi fe'llar odatda faqat Simple da: I like tea (I am liking emas).
• Hozir bo'lmasa ham 'bu davr' haqida Continuous ishlatiladi: I'm studying English this month.
• So'roq ham farq qiladi: Do you work? va Are you working?

examples.en: She is working at the moment.
Today they are going by bus.

mistakes.wrong: I am going to school every day.
mistakes.right: I go to school every day.

rules.tip: Every day, always, usually - Simple. Now, at the moment, look! - Continuous.

rules.title: Ko'plik shakli (Plurals)
rules.summary: Ot bir dona emas, bir nechta bo'lsa, oxiriga -s, -es yoki -ies qo'shamiz. Qaysi biri - so'zning oxiriga bog'liq.

sections.body:
Ko'plik (plural) - bir nechta narsa haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi: one apple - two apples.
Oddiy qoida: so'z oxiriga -s qo'shamiz: book - books, cat - cats.

• -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa: -es (bus - buses, dish - dishes, box - boxes, potato - potatoes)
• undosh + y: y tushadi, -ies (baby - babies, cherry - cherries)
• unli + y: faqat -s (boy - boys, toy - toys)
• -f / -fe: ko'pincha -ves (leaf - leaves, knife - knives)
• Istisno: radio - radios, photo - photos, roof - roofs

Ba'zi so'zlar butunlay boshqacha o'zgaradi - ularni yodlash kerak:
man - men
woman - women
child - children
foot - feet
tooth - teeth
person - people
Sheep va fish esa o'zgarmaydi: one sheep - two sheep.

O'zbek tilida ko'plik doim -lar qo'shimchasi bilan yasaladi (kitob - kitoblar). Inglizchada esa so'z oxiriga qarab turlicha: -s, -es, -ies va tartibsiz shakllar bor. Shuningdek, o'zbekchada 'ikkita kitob' deymiz (kitob birlikda), inglizchada esa 'two books' - ko'plikda.

examples.en: There are three boxes on the table.
We saw five sheep on the farm.

mistakes.why: Undosh + y bo'lsa, y tushib -ies bo'ladi.

rules.tip: Undosh + y = -ies (baby - babies), unli + y = faqat -s (boy - boys). 'y' dan oldingi harfga qara!

quiz.q: Two ___ are playing in the garden. (bola)
There are three ___ on the shelf. (quti)

rules.title: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar
rules.summary: Ba'zi narsalarni sanash mumkin (apple), ba'zilarini yo'q (milk). Bu farq a/an, some, much, many so'zlarini tanlashga ta'sir qiladi.

sections.body:
Sanaladigan ot (countable noun) - dona-dona sanash mumkin: an apple, two apples, three apples.
Sanalmaydigan ot (uncountable noun) - sanab bo'lmaydi: milk, water, rice, sugar, bread, money, information.

• Sanaladigan ot: a/an bilan keladi (a book), ko'plik shakli bor (books), fe'li ko'plikda are bo'ladi (the books are).
• Sanalmaydigan ot: a/an bilan KELMAYDI (a milk - xato), ko'plik shakli YO'Q (milks - xato), fe'li is bo'ladi (the milk is).
• Ikkalasi bilan some va any ishlatiladi.

Miqdor so'zi ishlatamiz: a glass of water, a loaf of bread, a bottle of milk, a piece of cake.
Bu qolip: miqdor so'zi + of + sanalmaydigan ot.

O'zbek tilida 'bitta suv' ham, 'ikki piyola choy' ham deyish mumkin. Inglizchada esa 'a water' deyilmaydi - 'a glass of water' deyiladi. Ayniqsa information, advice, money, news so'zlariga e'tibor ber: ular inglizchada sanalmaydi.

examples.en: I need an apple and some water.
examples.uz: Menga bitta olma va ozgina suv kerak.

examples.en: The milk is on the table.
She wants a glass of juice.
How much money do you have?
There is some rice in the bowl.

mistakes.right: I need two bottles of milk.
mistakes.why: Milk sanalmaydi; sanash uchun miqdor so'zi kerak.

rules.tip: Sanab bo'ladimi? Ha - a/an va -s. Yo'q - some va is. Sanamoqchi bo'lsang - miqdor so'zi + of.

quiz.q: There ___ some milk in the fridge.

quiz.why: Advice sanalmaydigan ot, a/an va -s olmaydi.

quiz.q: I'd like a ___ of bread, please.
quiz.why: a dan keyin birlik shakl: a slice of bread.

rules.title: Miqdor iboralari (a slice of ...)
rules.summary: Sanalmaydigan otlarni sanash uchun 'a bottle of, a glass of' kabi miqdor so'zlaridan foydalanamiz.

sections.body: Sanalmaydigan narsani (milk, bread, sugar) bo'laklarga yoki idishlarga bo'lib sanash kerak bo'lganda. Masalan: a bottle of water - bir shisha suv.

Qolip: a / two / three + miqdor so'zi + OF + ot
a slice of bread
two bottles of milk
Miqdor so'zi sanaladigan, shuning uchun ko'plikda -s oladi (two bottles), lekin asosiy ot o'zgarmaydi (milk).

• a slice of bread / cake
• a bottle of water / juice
• a glass of milk / juice
• a cup of tea / coffee
• a packet of sugar / rice
• a bowl of soup / cereal
• a loaf of bread
• a carton of milk
• a piece of cheese / paper
O'zbekcha 'bir piyola choy' deymiz, 'of' kerak emas. Inglizchada miqdor so'zi bilan ot orasida OF majburiy: a cup OF tea. Of ni tushirib qoldirma.

examples.en: I'd like a cup of tea.
She drinks two glasses of water a day.
examples.uz: U kuniga ikki stakan suv ichadi.

examples.en: Can I have a slice of cake?
We need a loaf of bread.
He bought a bottle of juice.
examples.uz: U bir shisha sharbat sotib oldi.

examples.en: There is a bowl of soup on the table.
examples.uz: Stol ustida bir kosa sho'rva bor.

examples.en: I want a packet of sugar.
Give me a piece of paper, please.

mistakes.why: Miqdor so'zi va ot orasida of kerak.

rules.tip: Miqdor so'zi + OF + ot. 'Of' ni hech qachon unutma!

quiz.why: 'a' dan keyin birlik shakl: a cup of coffee.

rules.title: How much / How many, a few / a little
rules.summary: Sanalmaydigan otlar bilan much va a little, sanaladigan otlar bilan many va a few ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
Miqdorni so'rash va aytish uchun:
• How many + sanaladigan ot (ko'plikda): How many eggs?
• How much + sanalmaydigan ot: How much milk?
• a few - bir nechta (sanaladigan): a few eggs
• a little - ozgina (sanalmaydigan): a little milk

How many apples do you need? - A few.
How much sugar do you need? - A little.
How much narx so'rashda ham ishlatiladi: How much is it? - Bu qancha turadi?

sections.h: Much va many inkor va so'roqda
sections.body:
Much va many asosan so'roq va inkor gaplarda ishlatiladi:
I don't have much time. Do you have many friends?
Tasdiq gapda ko'pincha a lot of ishlatiladi: I have a lot of friends.
O'zbekchada 'qancha' bitta so'z, inglizchada esa ikkita: many (sanaladigan) va much (sanalmaydigan). Bu juda muhim farq: 'qancha olma?' - how many apples, 'qancha sut?' - how much milk.

examples.en: How many eggs do you need?
How much milk do you need?
We have a lot of books.
How many students are in your class?

mistakes.wrong: How many water do you want?
mistakes.right: How much water do you want?

mistakes.wrong: How much apples do you need?
mistakes.right: How many apples do you need?

rules.tip: MANY - sanaladigan (dona-dona), MUCH - sanalmaydigan (suyuq, un, pul). Many apples, much milk.

rules.title: Some va Any
rules.summary: Some va any - 'biroz, bir nechta' ma'nosini beradi. Some tasdiq gapda, any inkor va so'roq gapda ishlatiladi.

sections.body: Aniq miqdorni aytmaymiz, lekin 'biroz' yoki 'bir nechta' demoqchi bo'lsak, some yoki any ishlatamiz. Ular sanaladigan (ko'plikda) va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan keladi.

• Tasdiq: some - I have some apples. I have some milk.
• Inkor: any - I don't have any apples.
• So'roq: any - Do you have any apples?
Lekin taklif va iltimosda so'roq gapda ham some ishlatiladi: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?

• There isn't any milk. = There is no milk.
• Some va any bilan a/an ishlatilmaydi.
• Some/any sanaladigan otlar bilan ko'plikda keladi: some apples (some apple - xato).
O'zbek tilida bunday ajratish yo'q: 'biroz non bor', 'non yo'q' deymiz. Inglizchada esa gap turiga qarab some yoki any tanlash kerak. Odatiy xato - hamma joyda some ishlatish.

examples.en: I have some friends in London.
There are some chairs in the room.
Can I have some water, please?
Are there any books on the table?

rules.tip: Tasdiq - some. Inkor va savol - any. Taklif qilsang - yana some.

rules.title: Joy predloglari (Prepositions of Place)
rules.summary: Joy predloglari narsa qayerda turganini aytadi: in, on, under, next to, between va boshqalar.

sections.body: Biror narsa yoki odam qayerda ekanini aytish uchun: The book is on the table. - Kitob stol ustida.

• in - ichida (in the box)
• on - ustida, sirtida (on the table)
• under - ostida (under the chair)
• next to / beside - yonida (next to the bank)
• between - ikkisining orasida (between the shop and the bank)
• in front of - oldida
• behind - orqasida
• opposite - qarshisida
• near - yaqinida

Where is the cat? - It is under the table.
Where are the keys? - They are in my bag.
Predlogdan keyin ot (yoki the + ot) keladi.

O'zbekchada joy ma'nosi qo'shimchalar bilan beriladi: stolda, stol ustida, stol ostida. Inglizchada esa ot oldida alohida so'z - predlog turadi: on the table. Ko'pincha 'in' va 'on' aralashtiriladi: in - ichida, on - sirtida.

examples.en: The keys are in my bag.
The book is on the table.
The dog is under the chair.
The bank is next to the post office.
The cafe is between the shop and the school.
The car is in front of the house.
The garden is behind the house.
The school is opposite the park.

mistakes.wrong: The book is in the table.
mistakes.right: The book is on the table.

mistakes.wrong: The cat is under of the bed.
mistakes.right: The cat is under the bed.
mistakes.why: Under dan keyin of kerak emas.

rules.tip: IN - ichida, ON - ustida/sirtida, UNDER - ostida. Rasm chizib ko'z oldingga keltir.

quiz.q: The shop is ___ the bank and the school. (orasida)
The picture is ___ the wall. (devorda osilgan)

rules.title: Was / Were (to be ning o'tgan zamoni)
rules.summary: Was va were - am/is/are ning o'tgan zamon shakli. Biror kishi yoki narsa o'tgan zamonda qayerda yoki qanday bo'lganini aytadi.

sections.body: O'tgan zamondagi holat, joy va xususiyatni aytish uchun: I was at home yesterday. - Kecha uyda edim.

I / he / she / it - WAS
we / you / they - WERE
Inkor: was not (wasn't), were not (weren't)
So'roq: Was he at home? Were they happy?
Qisqa javob: Yes, he was. / No, they weren't.
yesterday (kecha), last night (kecha kechasi), last week (o'tgan hafta), two days ago (ikki kun oldin), in 2010 (2010-yilda).
O'zbekchada 'edi' qo'shimchasi bor: uyda edim. Inglizchada was/were alohida so'z bo'lib, ega bilan moslashadi. You har doim were (bitta odamga ham): You were late.

examples.en: We were in Samarkand last summer.

rules.tip: I/he/she/it - WAS, boshqalar - WERE. So'roqda was/were gap boshiga chiqadi.

quiz.q: We ___ at the cinema last night.

quiz.why: She bilan was, savolda boshiga chiqadi.

rules.title: Had (have ning o'tgan zamoni)
rules.summary: Had - have/has ning o'tgan zamon shakli, hamma shaxs uchun bir xil. U 'bor edi' ma'nosini beradi.

sections.body: O'tgan zamonda biror narsa kimdadir bo'lganini aytganda: I had a bike when I was ten. - O'n yoshimda velosipedim bor edi.

Tasdiq: I / you / he / she / we / they + had
Inkor: didn't have (had not emas): I didn't have a car.
So'roq: Did you have a dog? - Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
Diqqat: did bor joyda have ishlatiladi, had emas.
yesterday, last year, when I was a child, in 1990, ten years ago.
O'zbekchada 'mening mashinam bor edi' deymiz. Inglizchada 'I had a car'. Inkor va savolda esa yordamchi fe'l did kerak, shunda asosiy fe'l asl holiga (have) qaytadi.

examples.en: I had a dog when I was a child.

mistakes.why: Did dan keyin asosiy fe'l asl holida.

rules.tip: O'tgan zamonda have = had (hamma uchun). Inkor va savolda: did + have.

quiz.why: Last year o'tgan zamonni bildiradi: had.

rules.title: Could (can ning o'tgan zamoni)
rules.summary: Could - 'qila olar edi' degan ma'noda o'tgan zamondagi qobiliyatni bildiradi. Hamma shaxslar uchun bir xil.

sections.body: O'tgan zamonda biror ishni qila olish yoki olmaslik haqida: When I was five, I could swim. - Besh yoshimda suza olar edim.

Tasdiq: I / you / he / she / we / they + could + fe'l (asl holida)
Inkor: couldn't (could not)
So'roq: Could you swim? - Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't.
Could dan keyin to yo'q, fe'l -s/-ed olmaydi: could swim.
Could 'can' ning o'tgan zamoni bo'lganda umumiy qobiliyatni bildiradi. Hamma shaxsga o'zgarmaydi: he could (he coulds - xato).
O'zbekchada 'qila olardim' deymiz. Inglizchada could + fe'l. Did bilan ishlatilmaydi: Did you could - xato, Could you - to'g'ri.

examples.en: I could swim when I was five.

examples.uz: U to'rt yoshida o'qiy olar edi.

examples.en: Could you ride a bike as a child?
My grandfather could play the piano.

rules.tip: Could = o'tgan zamondagi can. Keyin faqat oddiy fe'l: could + swim.

quiz.q: When I was young, I ___ run fast.

quiz.why: Could bilan savol: Could you swim?

rules.title: Past Simple: to'g'ri fe'llar
rules.summary: To'g'ri fe'llarda o'tgan zamon fe'lga -ed qo'shib yasaladi. Inkor va savolda did ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
O'tgan zamonda tugagan ish-harakat haqida: I watched TV yesterday. - Kecha televizor ko'rdim.
Vaqt so'zlari: yesterday, last week, in 2015, two days ago.

Tasdiq: ega + fe'l-ed: She worked. They played.
Inkor: ega + didn't + asl fe'l: She didn't work.
So'roq: Did + ega + asl fe'l? Did she work? - Yes, she did. / No, she didn't.
Did bor joyda fe'l -ed olmaydi!

• Oddiy fe'l: + ed (work - worked)
• -e bilan tugasa: + d (live - lived)
• undosh + y: y - ied (study - studied)
• unli + y: + ed (play - played)
• qisqa fe'l (undosh-unli-undosh): oxirgi harf ikkilanadi (stop - stopped)
O'zbekchada o'tgan zamon -di, -gan qo'shimchalari bilan yasaladi. Inglizchada -ed barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil, he/she uchun ham -s kerak emas: He worked (works emas).

examples.en: I watched a film last night.

mistakes.why: Didn't dan keyin fe'l asl holida.

rules.tip: DID bor joyda -ED yo'q! Did you watch? (watched emas). Faqat tasdiq gapda -ed.

rules.title: Tartibsiz fe'llar (Past Simple)
rules.summary: Ba'zi fe'llar -ed olmaydi, ularning o'tgan zamon shakli alohida. Ularni yodlash kerak.

sections.body: Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llarning ko'pchiligi tartibsiz. Tasdiq gapda ikkinchi shakl (past form) ishlatiladi: I went to school. - Maktabga bordim.

go - went
see - saw
have - had
buy - bought
eat - ate
drink - drank
take - took
make - made
come - came
get - got
write - wrote
read - read (yozilishi bir xil, o'qilishi 'red')

To'g'ri fe'llar bilan bir xil: did / didn't + asl fe'l.
I didn't go. Did you go? - Yes, I did.
Diqqat: did dan keyin went emas, go ishlatiladi.
Bu fe'llar o'zbekchadagi tartibsizlikka o'xshamaydi, shuning uchun jadval qilib yodlash kerak. Foydali usul: har kuni 3-5 ta fe'lni gapga solib aytish.

examples.en: I went to the market yesterday.
Did you go to the park?
She wrote a letter to her friend.

rules.tip: Tasdiq - ikkinchi shakl (went), inkor/savol - did + birinchi shakl (go).

rules.title: A / An / The (artikllar)
rules.summary: A/an noma'lum, birinchi marta tilga olingan bitta narsa oldidan; the esa aniq, ma'lum narsa oldidan keladi.

sections.body:
• a/an - birinchi marta aytilganda yoki 'bitta, biror' ma'nosida: I have a dog.
• the - aniq narsa, ikkalamiz biladigan narsa: The dog is big. (yuqorida aytilgan it)
• Yagona narsalar oldidan the: the sun, the moon, the Earth.

a - undosh tovush oldidan: a book, a university (yu- tovushi)
an - unli tovush oldidan: an apple, an hour (h aytilmaydi)
ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan a/an yo'q: books, water.
The - hamma uchun bir xil.

• Umumiy gapda ko'plik: I like dogs. (the dogs emas)
• Ko'pchilik shahar va mamlakat nomlari: London, Uzbekistan
• Kunlar va ovqat nomlari: have breakfast, on Monday
• go to school / go to bed / go home (umumiy faoliyat)

O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q, shuning uchun uni tushirib qoldirish yoki ortiqcha qo'yish odatiy xato. Yodda tut: sanaladigan birlik ot oldida deyarli har doim a/an yoki the kerak: I have a car (I have car - xato).

examples.en: I have a cat and a dog.
He went to a restaurant. The restaurant was good.
examples.uz: U restoranga bordi. Restoran yaxshi edi.

mistakes.why: Sanaladigan birlik ot oldida a/an kerak.

rules.tip: Birinchi marta - a/an. Ikkinchi marta - the. Unli tovush - an (an hour), undosh tovush - a (a university).

quiz.q: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
quiz.why: Elephant unli tovush bilan boshlanadi: an.

quiz.q: I have ___ new bag. ___ bag is red.

rules.title: Will (bashorat)
rules.summary: Will + fe'l kelajak haqida taxmin va bashorat qilish uchun ishlatiladi: It will rain tomorrow.

sections.body:
Kelajak haqida taxmin yoki fikr bildirganda: I think it will be sunny tomorrow. - Menimcha, ertaga havo ochiq bo'ladi.
Vaqt so'zlari: tomorrow, next week, in the future, soon.

Tasdiq: ega + will + fe'l (I'll, she'll, they'll)
Inkor: will not = won't: It won't rain.
So'roq: Will + ega + fe'l? Will it rain? - Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
Will hamma shaxs uchun bir xil, keyin fe'l asl holida.

• I think / I hope / probably bilan ko'p ishlatiladi: I think she will pass.
• Will dan keyin -s ham, to ham yo'q: she will go (she will goes - xato).
O'zbekchada kelasi zamon fe'l oxiridagi -adi, -ajak qo'shimchalari bilan beriladi. Inglizchada will + asl fe'l: will go. He/she/it uchun ham will o'zgarmaydi.

examples.en: I think she will pass the exam.
Will it be hot next week?
People will travel to Mars one day.
examples.uz: Odamlar bir kun Marsga sayohat qiladi.

examples.en: Will you be at home tonight?

mistakes.why: Will dan keyin to kerak emas.
Will not ning qisqa shakli: won't.

rules.tip: WILL + asl fe'l, har doim. Inkor - won't. Taxmin: I think ... will.

rules.title: Sanalar (Dates)
rules.summary: Inglizchada sana aytilganda tartib son (first, second, third) ishlatiladi va the va of bilan aytiladi.

sections.body: Tug'ilgan kun, bayram va voqea sanasini aytganda: My birthday is on the fifth of May. - Mening tug'ilgan kunim beshinchi mayda.

1st - first
2nd - second
3rd - third
4th - fourth ... 11th - eleventh, 12th - twelfth
20th - twentieth
21st - twenty-first
31st - thirty-first
Ko'p sonlar -th bilan tugaydi.

• Aytilishi: the + tartib son + of + oy: the tenth of June (yoki June the tenth)
• Yozilishi: 10 June yoki June 10
• Oldida predlog: on (kun), in (oy, yil): on 5 May, in May, in 2024
• Yil: 1999 - nineteen ninety-nine; 2024 - twenty twenty-four (yoki two thousand and twenty-four)
O'zbekchada '5-may' deymiz (son birinchi). Inglizchada ham 5 May deb yoziladi, lekin tartib son bilan aytiladi: the fifth of May. Tartib son (-th) ni unutma: five emas, fifth.

examples.en: My birthday is on the fifth of May.
The party is on the twenty-first of June.
The lesson is on the third of March.
Today is the twelfth of April.
We have a test on the second of December.

mistakes.wrong: It is the five of May.
mistakes.right: It is the fifth of May.

rules.tip: ON + aniq kun (on 5 May), IN + oy/yil (in May, in 2005). Sanada tartib son ishlat: fifth (five emas).

quiz.q: My birthday is ___ the third of June.

rules.title: Sifat va ravish (Adjectives & Adverbs)
rules.summary: Sifat otni tasvirlaydi (a quick car), ravish esa fe'lni tasvirlaydi (drives quickly). Ko'pchilik ravishlar sifatga -ly qo'shib yasaladi.

sections.body:
• Adjective (sifat) - ot qanday ekanini aytadi: a slow bus, a good student.
• Adverb (ravish) - ish qanday bajarilganini aytadi: He walks slowly. She speaks well.

• Ko'pchilik: sifat + ly: slow - slowly, quick - quickly, careful - carefully
• -y bilan tugasa: y - ily: happy - happily, easy - easily
• Tartibsiz: good - WELL, fast - fast, hard - hard, late - late
Sifat otdan oldin keladi (a nice day) yoki be dan keyin (He is nice). Ravish odatda fe'ldan keyin keladi.

• Good - sifat, well - ravish: She is a good singer. She sings well.
• Fast, hard, late ikkala vazifada ham bir xil: a fast car, drives fast.
• Look, feel, sound, taste fe'llaridan keyin sifat keladi: She looks happy.

O'zbekchada 'tez' ham sifat, ham ravish vazifasini bajaradi: tez mashina, tez yuguradi. Inglizchada esa ko'pincha ikki shakl bor: quick car - runs quickly. Eng ko'p xato: 'She sings good' (to'g'risi: well).

examples.en: The train is fast. It goes fast.

rules.tip: Ot haqida - sifat (quick). Ish haqida - ravish (quickly). Good - sifat, well - ravish.

rules.title: Bog'lovchilar: and, but, because, so, then, when
rules.summary: Bog'lovchilar gaplarni va fikrlarni bir-biriga ulaydi: and (va), but (lekin), because (chunki), so (shuning uchun).

sections.body:
Ikkita sodda gapni bitta murakkab gapga birlashtirish uchun:
• and - va (qo'shish): I like tea and coffee.
• but - lekin (qarama-qarshilik): I like tea but I don't like coffee.
• because - chunki (sabab): I stayed at home because I was ill.
• so - shuning uchun (natija): I was ill, so I stayed at home.
• when - qachonki: I was sleeping when you called.

Because sababni aytadi, so natijani aytadi. Ma'no bir xil, tartib teskari:
I was tired because I worked hard. (sabab keyin)
I worked hard, so I was tired. (natija keyin)

First (avval), then (keyin), after that (undan keyin), finally (oxirida) - voqealarni tartib bilan aytish uchun:
First I woke up. Then I had breakfast. After that I went to school.

O'zbekchada 'chunki' va 'shuning uchun' bor, ularni inglizcha because va so deb adashtirish oson. Esda tut: because + sabab, so + natija. 'Because' dan keyin gap boshlanmaydi: 'I was late. Because I missed the bus.' - uslubiy jihatdan noto'g'ri.

examples.en: I stayed at home because I was ill.
It was raining, so we took umbrellas.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, shuning uchun soyabon oldik.

examples.en: I was reading when he came.
First I had breakfast, then I went to work.
examples.uz: Avval nonushta qildim, keyin ishga bordim.

examples.en: He was tired but he finished the work.
examples.uz: U charchagan edi, lekin ishni tugatdi.

examples.en: We were late because the bus was slow.

mistakes.wrong: I was late, because I missed the bus, so.
mistakes.right: I was late because I missed the bus.

mistakes.wrong: I stayed at home so I was ill.
mistakes.right: I stayed at home because I was ill.

mistakes.wrong: I was tired, because I went to bed.
mistakes.right: I was tired, so I went to bed.

rules.tip: BECAUSE - sabab, SO - natija. Gap bo'lakni ulash: and/but/so oldidan vergul qo'yish mumkin.

quiz.q: I was hungry, ___ I ate a sandwich.
He didn't come ___ he was ill.
I like pizza ___ I don't like pasta.

rules.title: Harakat predloglari (Prepositions of Movement)
rules.summary: Harakat predloglari qayerga yoki qayerdan qanday harakat qilinishini bildiradi: to, into, out of, across, along, up, down, through.

sections.body: Harakatning yo'nalishini aytish uchun: He walked into the room. - U xonaga kirdi.

• to - ...ga: go to school
• into - ichiga: run into the house
• out of - ichidan tashqariga: come out of the shop
• across - narigi tomonga (kesib): walk across the road
• along - bo'ylab: walk along the river
• up / down - yuqoriga / pastga: go up the stairs, go down the hill
• through - ichidan o'tib: go through the tunnel
• past - yonidan o'tib: walk past the bank
• round / around - aylanib: run round the park

fe'l + predlog + joy: walk across the bridge, go through the park.
Yo'nalish joyni bildiradi (in/on), harakat esa to/into: I am in the room (turibman) - I go into the room (kiraman).

O'zbekchada yo'nalish qo'shimchalar bilan beriladi: xonaga, ko'chadan o'tib. Inglizchada har bir yo'nalish uchun alohida predlog bor. 'Into' va 'in', 'to' va 'at' ni aralashtirma: in - joy, into - harakat.

examples.en: The cat came out of the box.
The train goes through the tunnel.

mistakes.right: He came out of the house.

rules.tip: IN - ichida (turish), INTO - ichiga (harakat). OUT OF - ichidan chiqish.

rules.title: Ega va to'ldiruvchi savollari
rules.summary: Savolda so'z ega bo'lib kelsa (kim? nima?), did/does/do ishlatilmaydi. To'ldiruvchi bo'lib kelsa ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
Who va what savollari ikki xil bo'ladi:
• Ega savoli (subject question): ish kim bajargani so'raladi.
  Who called you? - Anna called me.
• To'ldiruvchi savoli (object question): ish kimga/nimaga bajarilgani so'raladi.
  Who did you call? - I called Anna.

Ega savoli: Who / What + fe'l (did yo'q): Who wrote this book? What happened?
To'ldiruvchi savoli: Who / What + did/does/do + ega + asl fe'l: What did you eat? Who do you like?
Ega savolida who/what egani o'rnini egallaydi, shuning uchun yordamchi fe'l kerak emas.

• Who bilan fe'l odatda birlikda: Who lives here? (live-s: Who lives).
• Present Simple ega savoli: Who likes tea? (likes).
• Past Simple ega savoli: Who broke the window? (broke - 2-shakl, did yo'q).
O'zbekchada 'kim ko'rdi?' va 'kimni ko'rdingiz?' o'zgarmaydi, tartibi ham o'zgarmaydi. Inglizchada esa ega savolida did kerak emas: Who saw you? (Who did see you - xato).

rules.tip: Who + fe'l = ega (did yo'q). Who + did + ega + fe'l = to'ldiruvchi.

quiz.why: To'ldiruvchi savoli: did + ega + asl fe'l.

rules.title: Comparative: taqqoslash (-er, more)
rules.summary: Ikki narsani taqqoslash uchun sifatga -er qo'shamiz yoki more ishlatamiz, keyin than keladi.

sections.body: Ikki narsa yoki odamni solishtirganda: My bag is bigger than your bag. - Mening sumkam seningnikidan kattaroq.

• Qisqa sifat (1 bo'g'in): + er: tall - taller, small - smaller
• -e bilan tugasa: + r: nice - nicer
• undosh + y: y - ier: happy - happier, easy - easier
• Bitta unli + bitta undosh: undosh ikkilanadi: big - bigger, hot - hotter
• Uzun sifat (2+ bo'g'in): more + sifat: more interesting, more expensive
Qolip: A + is + comparative + than + B.

good - better
bad - worse
far - farther/further
Bu shakllarga -er qo'shilmaydi: gooder - xato.

O'zbekchada -roq qo'shimchasi bor: kattaroq, tezroq. Inglizchada ham -er yoki more. Lekin 'than' (...dan) kerak: seningnikidan - than yours. Eng ko'p xato: more bilan -er birga ishlatish (more bigger - xato).

examples.en: My brother is taller than me.
This book is more interesting than that one.
English is easier than I thought.
This phone is more expensive than that phone.
My English is better than my French.

mistakes.wrong: She is more tall than me.

rules.tip: Qisqa sifat + ER + than. Uzun sifat: MORE + sifat + than. Good - better, bad - worse.

quiz.q: This film is ___ than that one. (qiziqarli)

rules.title: Superlative: eng (-est, most)
rules.summary: Uch va undan ortiq narsa ichida eng yuqori darajani aytish uchun sifatga -est qo'shamiz yoki most ishlatamiz, oldidan the keladi.

sections.body: Guruh ichidan birini ajratib: She is the tallest girl in the class. - U sinfdagi eng baland qiz.

• Qisqa sifat: the + sifat-est: tall - the tallest, small - the smallest
• -e bilan tugasa: the nicest
• undosh + y: the happiest
• Bitta unli + bitta undosh: the biggest, the hottest
• Uzun sifat: the most + sifat: the most interesting, the most expensive
• Tartibsiz: the best, the worst, the farthest

Superlativdan oldin doim THE keladi. Keyin ko'pincha in yoki of keladi:
the tallest in the class (joy/guruh: in)
the best of all (hammadan: of)
O'zbekchada 'eng' so'zi bor: eng katta. Inglizchada eng = the + -est yoki the most. The ni tushirib qoldirish tipik xato: 'He is tallest boy' - xato.

examples.en: She is the tallest girl in the class.
This is the most beautiful city.
He is the best player in the team.
It was the hottest day of the year.
examples.uz: Bu yilning eng issiq kuni edi.

examples.en: Tom is the happiest of all.
This is the most expensive hotel in town.
Who is the youngest in your family?
That was the worst film I've seen.
examples.uz: Bu men ko'rgan eng yomon film edi.

mistakes.wrong: It is the best of the class.
mistakes.right: It is the best in the class.

rules.tip: THE + sifat-EST, yoki THE MOST + uzun sifat. Oldida the unutilmasin!

quiz.q: He is ___ boy in the class. (baland)

rules.title: As ... as (teng taqqoslash)
rules.summary: As + sifat + as ikki narsaning teng ekanini bildiradi, not as ... as esa teng emasligini.

sections.body:
Ikki narsa bir xil darajada bo'lsa: He is as tall as me. - U men kabi baland.
Biri ikkinchisidan kam bo'lsa: She is not as tall as me. - U men kabi baland emas.

Teng: as + sifat (asl shakl) + as: as big as, as old as
Teng emas: not as + sifat + as: not as fast as
Sifat asl holida qoladi (as taller as - xato).

• The same as: My bag is the same size as yours.
• Not as ... as ma'nosi bo'yicha comparative ga yaqin: He isn't as old as me = I am older than him.
O'zbekchada 'sendek baland', 'sen kabi baland' deymiz. Inglizchada ikkita as kerak: as tall as you. Birinchi as ni tushirib qoldirish odatiy xato.

examples.en: He is as tall as his father.
My phone is as good as yours.
This book is not as interesting as that one.
examples.uz: Bu kitob u kitobchalik qiziqarli emas.

examples.en: She runs as fast as me.
Cats aren't as big as dogs.
Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
This bag is as expensive as that one.
I am as old as my cousin.

mistakes.wrong: He is as taller as me.
mistakes.right: He is as tall as me.
mistakes.why: As ... as orasida sifat asl shaklda.

mistakes.right: She is as tall as me.

mistakes.wrong: It is not as bigger as that.
mistakes.right: It is not as big as that.

rules.tip: AS + oddiy sifat + AS. Sifatga -er yoki more qo'shilmaydi!

quiz.q: He is as ___ as his brother.
My room is as big ___ yours.

rules.title: Be going to (reja va niyat)
rules.summary: Be going to oldindan rejalashtirgan ishlar va hozirgi belgilarga asoslangan bashorat uchun ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
• Reja va niyat: I'm going to visit my grandmother tomorrow. - Ertaga buvimning oldiga bormoqchiman (rejalashtirganman).
• Hozir ko'rinib turgan belgi: Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.

Tasdiq: ega + am/is/are + going to + fe'l: She is going to study.
Inkor: ega + am/is/are + not + going to + fe'l: I'm not going to go.
So'roq: Am/Is/Are + ega + going to + fe'l? Are you going to come? - Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Going to dan keyin asl fe'l keladi.
tomorrow, tonight, next week, next year, this weekend, soon.

O'zbekchada 'bormoqchiman, qilaman' deymiz, reja ham, oddiy kelasi zamon ham bir xil shaklda. Inglizchada reja uchun going to, o'sha payt qaror qilingan ish uchun will ishlatiladi. Be (am/is/are) ni tushirib qoldirma: I going to - xato.

examples.en: I'm going to visit my friend tomorrow.
She is going to buy a new phone.
We are going to play football on Sunday.
Are you going to study tonight?
What are you going to do this weekend?
He is going to be a doctor.

mistakes.why: Going to dan keyin asl fe'l.

rules.tip: AM/IS/ARE + going to + asl fe'l. Reja yoki belgi bo'lsa - going to.

quiz.q: We ___ going to travel next month.
She is going to ___ a doctor.
quiz.why: Going to dan keyin asl fe'l.

rules.title: Will (spontan qaror, va'da, taklif)
rules.summary: Will qaror o'sha paytda qabul qilinganda, va'da va taklifda ishlatiladi. Shakli hamma shaxs uchun bir xil.

sections.body:
• Gap paytida qabul qilingan qaror: The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
• Va'da: I'll call you tomorrow.
• Taklif: I'll help you with the bags.
• Taxmin: It will be cold tomorrow.

Tasdiq: ega + will ('ll) + asl fe'l
Inkor: will not = won't
So'roq: Will + ega + fe'l? - Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
Diqqat: shall asosan I va we bilan taklifda: Shall I open the window?

• Going to - oldindan reja: I'm going to buy a car (o'ylab qo'yganman).
• Will - shu zahoti qaror: Oh, it's cold. I'll close the window.
O'zbekchada oldindan rejalashtirilgan va shu zahoti qilingan ishlar bir xil shaklda ifodalanadi. Inglizchada bu ikki xil: reja - going to, tezkor qaror - will.

examples.en: It's hot. I'll open the window.
I'll help you with your homework.
Will you come to my party?
I think he'll win the game.

rules.tip: Shu zahoti qaror - WILL. Oldindan reja - GOING TO.

quiz.q: The phone is ringing. I ___ answer it.
I ___ help you with the bag. (taklif)

rules.title: Present Continuous kelajak uchun
rules.summary: Aniq kelishilgan reja (vaqt va joy belgilangan) haqida gapirganda Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
Bu yaqin kelajakdagi aniq tayyorlangan rejalar uchun: I'm meeting Anna at five. - Soat beshda Anna bilan uchrashaman (kelishib qo'yganman).
Odatda vaqt so'zi bo'ladi: tomorrow, tonight, on Friday, next week.

Am/is/are + fe'l-ing: We are flying to Moscow on Monday.
Inkor: I'm not working tomorrow.
So'roq: Are you coming tonight?
Shakli oddiy Present Continuous bilan bir xil, faqat ma'nosi kelajakka qaratilgan.

Ikkalasi ham reja uchun ishlatiladi:
I'm going to see a film. (niyat)
I'm seeing a film at 8 with Anna. (aniq kelishuv, vaqt bor)
Beginner darajada ularni almashtirsa bo'ladi, lekin hozirgi paytda ketayotgan ishda faqat Present Continuous.

O'zbekchada 'ertaga ketyapman' deyish mumkin. Inglizchada ham shunday: 'I am leaving tomorrow'. Demak, hozirgi zamon shakli kelajak ma'nosida ishlatiladi. Vaqt so'zi (tomorrow, on Monday) ma'noni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: I'm meeting my friend at five.
We are flying to Moscow on Monday.
She is having a party on Saturday.
They are visiting us next week.
examples.uz: Ular kelasi hafta bizning oldimizga keladi.

examples.en: He is playing tennis at six.
What are you doing on Sunday?

mistakes.wrong: I meet Anna tomorrow at five.
mistakes.right: I'm meeting Anna tomorrow at five.

mistakes.wrong: We going to Moscow on Monday.
mistakes.right: We are going to Moscow on Monday.

rules.tip: Reja + aniq vaqt = Present Continuous: I'm meeting Anna at five.

rules.title: Will va going to farqi
rules.summary: Will tezkor qaror yoki taxmin uchun, going to oldindan reja va belgi asosidagi bashorat uchun.

sections.body:
• Going to: oldindan o'ylangan reja (I'm going to buy a car), hozir ko'rinib turgan belgi (Look at those clouds - it's going to rain).
• Will: shu zahoti qaror (I'll have the soup), va'da, taklif, belgisiz taxmin (I think it will be hot).

Reja: A: Why are you buying flour? B: I'm going to make a cake.
Tezkor qaror: A: We haven't got any milk. B: I'll go and buy some.
Belgi: Look! The man is going to fall.
Taxmin: I think people will live on Mars.
Agar maxsus belgi yoki reja bo'lmasa, ikkalasi ham ishlatilishi mumkin, ayniqsa taxminda. Eng ishonchli yo'l: oldindan o'ylab qo'yilgan bo'lsa - going to, shu paytda qaror qilingan bo'lsa - will.
O'zbekchada ikkalasi bitta shaklda: 'ertaga qilaman'. Inglizchada tanlash kerak. O'zingga savol ber: 'Buni oldin o'ylab qo'yganmanmi?' Ha - going to. Yo'q, hozir qaror qildim - will.

examples.en: Oh, it's cold. I'll close the window.
Look at the sky! It's going to rain.
I think it will rain tomorrow.
A: I can't open this. B: I'll help you.
examples.uz: A: Buni ocholmayapman. B: Men yordam beraman.

examples.en: We're going to move to a new house.
I'll call you later, I promise.
She is going to have a baby.

mistakes.wrong: A: I'm cold. B: I'm going to close the window.
mistakes.right: A: I'm cold. B: I'll close the window.

mistakes.wrong: I will visit my aunt tomorrow, I planned it last week.
mistakes.right: I'm going to visit my aunt tomorrow, I planned it last week.

rules.tip: Oldindan o'ylab qo'ygan bo'lsang - GOING TO. Hozirgina qaror qilsang - WILL.

quiz.q: A: We have no bread. B: I ___ buy some.
I ___ visit Paris next summer. I've bought the tickets.
Look at that car! It ___ crash!

rules.title: Sabab, natija va maqsad (because, so, to)
rules.summary: Because - sabab, so - natija, to + fe'l - maqsad (nima uchun?) ni bildiradi.

sections.body:
• Because + gap: sababni aytadi. I'm going to bed early because I'm tired.
• So + gap: natijani aytadi. I'm tired, so I'm going to bed early.
• To + fe'l: maqsad. I'm going to the shop to buy milk. - Sut sotib olish uchun do'konga ketyapman.

Why? savoliga javob:
Why are you going to the shop? - To buy some milk. / Because I need some milk.
Maqsad: fe'l + to + asl fe'l (go to the shop to buy). To dan keyin ega yoki will ishlatilmaydi.

To (maqsad) dan keyin faqat fe'l: I went there to see him. (to for see him - xato).
For + ot ham mumkin: I went to the shop for milk.
O'zbekchada 'sut olish uchun' deymiz (-ish uchun). Inglizchada 'to buy milk' - 'for buying milk' ham emas. Because dan keyin to'liq gap (ega + fe'l) keladi.

examples.en: I'm going to bed early because I'm tired.
I'm tired, so I'm going to bed.
I'm going to the shop to buy milk.
She studies hard to pass the exam.
examples.uz: U imtihondan o'tish uchun qattiq o'qiydi.

examples.en: We use a pen to write.
Why are you learning English? To get a job.
examples.uz: Nega ingliz tili o'rganyapsiz? Ish topish uchun.

examples.en: He took an umbrella because it was raining.
examples.uz: U yomg'ir yog'ayotgani uchun soyabon oldi.

examples.en: It's raining, so we'll stay at home.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir yog'yapti, shuning uchun uyda qolamiz.

mistakes.wrong: I go to the shop for to buy milk.
mistakes.right: I go to the shop to buy milk.

mistakes.wrong: I'm tired because I will go to bed.
mistakes.right: I'm tired, so I'll go to bed.

mistakes.wrong: He called me for ask a question.
mistakes.right: He called me to ask a question.

rules.tip: Why? - to + fe'l yoki because + gap. Natija - so.

quiz.q: I'm going to the bank ___ get some money.
I'm hungry, ___ I'm going to eat.
I stayed home ___ I was ill.

rules.title: Should / Shouldn't (maslahat)
rules.summary: Should va shouldn't maslahat berish uchun ishlatiladi: 'kerak, yaxshi bo'lardi' va 'kerak emas'.

sections.body:
Birovga maslahat berganda: You should see a doctor. - Shifokorga ko'rinishing kerak (yaxshi bo'ladi).
Majburiyat emas, aynan maslahat.

Tasdiq: ega + should + asl fe'l: You should rest.
Inkor: shouldn't (should not): You shouldn't eat too much.
So'roq: Should + ega + fe'l? Should I go? - Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.
Hamma shaxs uchun bir xil; fe'l -s va to olmaydi.

• I think you should ...
• You should ... / You shouldn't ...
• What should I do? - Nima qilishim kerak?
• Why don't you ...? - Nega ... qilmaysan?
O'zbekchada 'kerak' so'zi ham majburiyat, ham maslahat uchun. Inglizchada ikki xil: should - maslahat (yumshoq), must - majburiyat (kuchli). 'Should' ni 'must' bilan almashtirma.

examples.en: You shouldn't eat so much sugar.
I think you should study more.
He should go to bed early.

rules.tip: Should = yaxshi bo'lardi (maslahat). Keyin faqat oddiy fe'l.

quiz.q: You have a headache. You ___ rest.
You ___ eat too much sugar. (maslahat: yo'q)

rules.title: Must / Mustn't (majburiyat va taqiq)
rules.summary: Must - 'kerak, shart' (majburiyat), mustn't - 'mumkin emas' (taqiq). Qoidalar va belgilarda ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
Qoida, qonun va kuchli zaruratni aytganda: You must wear a seat belt. - Xavfsizlik kamarini taqish shart.
Taqiq: You mustn't smoke here. - Bu yerda chekish mumkin emas.

Tasdiq: ega + must + asl fe'l: I must go.
Inkor: mustn't (must not): You mustn't park here.
So'roq: Must + ega + fe'l? Must I go?
Must hamma shaxs uchun bir xil, keyin to yo'q.

sections.h: Mustn't va don't have to farqi
sections.body:
• Mustn't = taqiq, mumkin emas: You mustn't talk in the exam.
• Don't have to = shart emas (xohlasang mumkin): You don't have to come.
Bu ikki ibora ma'nosi butunlay boshqa!
O'zbekchada 'kerak emas' ham 'mumkin emas', ham 'shart emas' ma'nosida ishlatilishi mumkin. Inglizchada: mustn't - mumkin emas, don't have to - shart emas.

examples.en: You must wear a seat belt.
You mustn't use your phone in the exam.
We must stop at a red light.
Children mustn't play near the road.
I must finish my homework tonight.
examples.uz: Bugun kechqurun uy vazifamni tugatishim shart.

rules.tip: MUST - shart. MUSTN'T - mumkin emas. Don't have to - shart emas.

quiz.q: You ___ cross the road when the light is red.

rules.title: Can / Can't va Could / Couldn't
rules.summary: Can - hozirgi qobiliyat yoki ruxsat, could - o'tgan zamon qobiliyati va muloyim iltimos.

sections.body:
• Qobiliyat: I can swim. (suza olaman)
• Ruxsat: Can I sit here? (o'tirsam bo'ladimi?)
• Imkoniyat yo'qligi: I can't help you. (yordam bera olmayman)
• O'tgan zamon: I could swim when I was six. I couldn't read then.
• Muloyim iltimos: Could you open the door, please?

Can / can't (cannot) + asl fe'l: she can sing.
Could / couldn't + asl fe'l: he couldn't see.
So'roq: Can you swim? Could you help me?
Hamma shaxs uchun bir xil, -s olmaydi.

• Can - hozir, could - o'tgan zamon.
• Could you ...? can you ...? dan muloyimroq.
• Can't - qila olmaslik (I can't swim) yoki taqiq (You can't park here).
O'zbekchada 'qila olaman' deyiladi: qobiliyat va ruxsat bitta qo'shimcha bilan. Inglizchada can bor, o'tgan zamonda could. Can dan keyin to ishlatilmaydi: I can to swim - xato.

examples.en: I could ride a bike when I was six.
examples.uz: Olti yoshimda velosiped minishni bilar edim.

rules.tip: Can - hozir, could - o'tgan zamon yoki muloyim iltimos. Keyin faqat asl fe'l.

quiz.q: When I was a child, I ___ climb trees.

rules.title: Always, never va qoidalar
rules.summary: Always (doim) va never (hech qachon) bilan qoidalarni, odatlarni va maslahatlarni aytamiz: You should always..., You must never...

sections.body:
Qoida va odatlarni umumiy tarzda aytganda: You should always wash your hands. - Doim qo'llaringizni yuvishingiz kerak.
You must never touch a hot stove. - Qaynoq pechga hech qachon tegmaslik kerak.

Always va never modal fe'ldan (should, must, can) KEYIN, asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN keladi:
You should always be careful.
You must never run on the stairs.
Oddiy fe'l bilan: I always get up early. He never eats meat. (be dan keyin: She is always late.)

• Never o'zida inkor ma'nosini bor, shuning uchun not kerak emas: I never smoke. (I don't never smoke - xato)
• Always va never ikkalasi ham to'liq (100%) ma'noda.
• Qoidalar uchun: must always (shart), should always (maslahat), must never (taqiq), should never (kuchli maslahat).
O'zbekchada 'hech qachon' bilan inkor fe'l ishlatiladi: hech qachon qilmayman. Inglizchada never bor, shuning uchun fe'l tasdiqda turadi: I never eat meat (I don't never eat - xato).

examples.en: You should always brush your teeth.
You must never touch the fire.
I always get up at six.
You should never talk to strangers.
examples.uz: Begona odamlar bilan hech qachon gaplashmaslik kerak.

examples.en: We must always wear a seat belt.
Children should never play with matches.
examples.uz: Bolalar hech qachon gugurt bilan o'ynamasligi kerak.

mistakes.why: Never o'zi inkor, qo'shimcha not kerak emas.

rules.tip: Modal + always/never + fe'l (should always wash). Never o'zi inkor!

quiz.q: We ___ wear a seat belt. (doim, shart)

rules.title: Present Perfect: shakli (have/has + 3-shakl)
rules.summary: Present Perfect o'tgan ish bilan hozirgi payt orasidagi bog'lanishni ko'rsatadi: have/has + past participle (fe'lning 3-shakli).

sections.body:
O'tgan zamonda sodir bo'lgan, lekin natijasi hozirga aloqador ish-harakat uchun: I have lost my keys. - Kalitlarimni yo'qotganman (hozir yo'q).
Aniq vaqt aytilmasa, Present Perfect ishlatiladi.
