Tasdiq: I/you/we/they + have + 3-shakl; he/she/it + has + 3-shakl
Inkor: haven't / hasn't + 3-shakl: She hasn't finished.
So'roq: Have/Has + ega + 3-shakl? Have you eaten? - Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
Qisqa shakl: I've, you've, he's, she's.

• To'g'ri fe'llar: fe'l + ed (worked, played, studied) - Past Simple bilan bir xil.
• Tartibsiz: go - gone, see - seen, eat - eaten, write - written, take - taken, do - done, give - given, buy - bought, have - had, make - made.
Tartibsiz fe'llarning 3-shaklini yodlash kerak.
O'zbekchada '-gan' qo'shimchasi bor: borgan, ko'rgan, yozgan. Present Perfect aynan shunga yaqin: I have seen - ko'rganman. Inglizchada have/has ega bilan moslashadi (he has, they have).

examples.en: They have bought a new car.

rules.tip: HAVE/HAS + 3-shakl. Go - went - GONE; see - saw - SEEN. 3-shaklni alohida yodla.

rules.title: Present Perfect + ever / never
rules.summary: Ever va never bilan hayotiy tajribani so'raymiz va aytamiz: 'Hech qachon ...ganmisiz?', 'Men hech qachon ...ganman'.

sections.body:
Butun hayot davomida bo'lgan yoki bo'lmagan tajriba haqida:
Have you ever been to London? - Hech Londonda bo'lganmisiz?
I've never been to London. - Men hech qachon Londonda bo'lmaganman.

• So'roq: Have you ever + 3-shakl? - Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
• Never (hech qachon) o'zi inkor: I have never seen snow. (I haven't never - xato)
• Ever so'roq gapda ishlatiladi, never tasdiq shaklidagi gapda.
Ever/never have/has va 3-shakl o'rtasida turadi.

• Ever tasdiq gapda: It's the best film I've ever seen (superlative bilan).
• Been - borib kelgan (tajriba), gone - ketgan (hozir shu yerda emas).
O'zbekchada 'hech' so'zi so'roq va inkorda ishlatiladi: hech ko'rganmisiz? Hech ko'rmaganman. Inglizchada ever (so'roq) va never (javob) ishlatiladi. Never bilan inkor fe'l kerak emas.

examples.en: Have you ever been to London?
Have they ever met a famous person?

rules.title: Present Perfect + just / already / yet
rules.summary: Just - hozirgina, already - allaqachon, yet - hali (so'roq va inkorda).

sections.body:
• just - hozirgina bo'lgan ish: I've just finished. - Hozirgina tugatdim.
• already - kutilganidan oldin yoki allaqachon: She has already left. - U allaqachon ketdi.
• yet - so'roq va inkorda 'hali': Have you finished yet? I haven't finished yet.

Just va already: have/has va 3-shakl o'rtasida: I have just eaten. She has already called.
Yet: gap oxirida: Have you done it yet? He hasn't come yet.

• Yet tasdiq gapda ishlatilmaydi.
• Already so'roq gapda ham ishlatiladi (hayrat bilan): Have you finished already?
• Bu so'zlar bilan Present Perfect (British) ishlatiladi.
O'zbekchadagi 'hali' inkorda va so'roqda ishlatiladi: hali kelmadi. Inglizchada: hasn't come YET. Tasdiq gapda yet emas, already ishlatiladi.

rules.tip: Just/already - o'rtada. Yet - oxirida (savol/inkor).

rules.title: For va since
rules.summary: For - qancha vaqt davomida (muddat), since - qachondan beri (boshlanish nuqtasi).

sections.body:
Present Perfect bilan davomiylikni aytganda:
• for + muddat: for two years, for a week, for an hour
• since + boshlanish: since 2020, since Monday, since 9 o'clock
I have lived here for ten years. = I have lived here since 2015.

I/you/we/they have + 3-shakl + for/since...
He/she/it has + 3-shakl + for/since...
So'roq: How long have you lived here?
Javob: For three years. / Since 2022.

• For - vaqt uzunligi (qancha?), since - vaqt nuqtasi (qachondan?).
• Since dan keyin sana yoki payt: since Monday, since I was a child.
• Bu fe'llar bilan ko'p ishlatiladi: live, know, work, have, be.

O'zbekchada 'ikki yildan beri' ham muddat, ham boshlanish uchun ishlatiladi: ikki yildan beri / 2022-yildan beri. Inglizchada ajratiladi: for two years - since 2022. Yodda tut: since dan keyin 'qachon' keladi.

examples.en: I have lived here for ten years.
examples.uz: Men bu yerda o'n yildan beri yashayman.

mistakes.wrong: I have lived here since ten years.
mistakes.right: I have lived here for ten years.

mistakes.wrong: I live here for ten years.
mistakes.right: I have lived here for ten years.

rules.tip: FOR + qancha (two years). SINCE + qachondan (2020, Monday).

quiz.q: She has lived here ___ five years.

rules.title: Been va gone
rules.summary: Been - borib kelgan (qaytib kelgan), gone - ketib qolgan (hozir yo'q). Ikkalasi ham go ning 3-shakli.

sections.body:
• Has been to - borgan va qaytgan: She has been to Paris. (Parijda bo'lgan, hozir bu yerda.)
• Has gone to - ketgan, hozir u yerda yoki yo'lda: She has gone to Paris. (Parijga ketgan, hozir shu yerda emas.)

have/has + been + to + joy: I have been to London.
have/has + gone + to + joy: He has gone to the shop.
Savol: Have you ever been to ...? (tajriba).

• Been tajriba uchun: Have you ever been to Samarkand?
• Gone - hozir shu yerda yo'qligini bildiradi: Where is Tom? He has gone out.
• I have gone to ... deyish odatda noto'g'ri (o'zing haqida): I have been to... deyiladi.
O'zbekchada 'borgan' bitta so'z, lekin ma'no kontekstdan tushuniladi. Inglizchada ikki xil: been - qaytgan, gone - qaytmagan. Bu farq muhim: 'He has gone to Paris' deyish - 'U hali qaytmagan'.

examples.en: I have never been to Japan.
Where is Tom? He has gone to the shop.
Have you ever been to Samarkand?
We have been to the cinema twice.

mistakes.wrong: I have gone to London three times.
mistakes.right: I have been to London three times.

mistakes.wrong: Where is Ann? She has been to the bank.
mistakes.right: Where is Ann? She has gone to the bank.

mistakes.wrong: He has been in Paris, so he is not here.
mistakes.right: He has gone to Paris, so he is not here.

rules.tip: BEEN = borib qaytgan. GONE = ketgan, hali qaytmagan.

quiz.q: Where is Sam? He has ___ to the market.

rules.title: Present Perfect va Past Simple farqi
rules.summary: Aniq o'tgan vaqt aytilsa Past Simple, aniq vaqt aytilmasa yoki hozirga aloqador bo'lsa Present Perfect ishlatiladi.

sections.body:
• Past Simple: tugagan, aniq vaqt belgilangan ish: I saw him yesterday. I went to London in 2019.
• Present Perfect: vaqt aytilmagan yoki hozirgacha davom etgan, natijasi hozirga aloqador: I have seen him. I have lived here for five years.

• Past Simple bilan: yesterday, last week, in 2019, two days ago, when I was a child.
• Present Perfect bilan: ever, never, just, already, yet, for, since, so far, this week.
Agar gapda aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, ago, in 2019) bo'lsa - Present Perfect ishlatib bo'lmaydi!

What time did you ...? (aniq vaqt - Past Simple)
Have you ever ...? (tajriba - Present Perfect)
How long have you ...? (davomiylik - Present Perfect)
When did you ...? (qachon - Past Simple)
O'zbekchada 'ko'rdim' va 'ko'rganman' ikki xil. Inglizchada ham: saw - ko'rdim (aniq payt), have seen - ko'rganman (tajriba, natija). Yesterday, ago, last bilan 'have seen' ishlatish eng ko'p xato.

examples.en: We lived in Bukhara for five years.
We have lived here for five years.
examples.uz: Biz bu yerda besh yildan beri yashaymiz.

rules.tip: Aniq vaqt (yesterday, ago, in 2019) = Past Simple. Vaqt yo'q yoki ever/never/just/yet/for/since = Present Perfect.
